lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity are visible intersecting with the high-luminance circular nodes, forming a primary grid-like lattice across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible on the upper flank, characterized by sharp vertical luminance gradients with high-intensity upper edges and low-intensity shadow regions immediately below.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin displays a high-density gradient of small, high-luminance spots concentrated along the anterior leading edge, transitioning to larger, more widely spaced spots toward the posterior margin.
